requiredFindings.title: Both new boundary predicates omit directory-custody and depth exclusions
requiredFindings.finding: _member_consistency and _outside_markers call classify_boundary with only nestedRepositories/nestedProjects. The selected native _boundary_hit additionally applies classify_custody_exclusion, and directory-custody/DEPTH rows are admitted boundaries. The omission contradicts B-S1 member-consistency and the proposed NE:838 outside-every-admitted-boundary meaning. A valid V3 inventory excluding blocked by DIRECTORY_CUSTODY:ACL_UNREADABLE, with a root package marker and blocked/node_modules/x/package.json, wrongly refuses missingAnchors=blocked/node_modules. A carried blocked/.git anchor also wrongly refuses member-not-admitted, although its parent is already outside the project. The staged checker passes because it lacks these combinations.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Use the full selected boundary predicate in both places, including directory-custody and DEPTH exclusions while preserving marker-only custody semantics. For LD-B2C0-1, determine whether the derived pruned anchor itself is at or below a boundary, as the override states. Add synthetic regressions for DIRECTORY_CUSTODY and DEPTH, carried and derived anchors, and marker-only custody not excluding unrelated content; retain the outside-boundary mismatch controls.
